market_summary: W34 closed at 4,602.66 (+226.50, +5.18%), in the top 10% of the weekly range, clearing the W32–W33 consolidation high at 4,449.73. The move was triggered on 08-19, when price swept the prior day's low at 4,329.415 and reversed to close at 4,522.043 (+188.63 on the day) as the dollar index broke below its daily 200 EMA at 99.612. Both producers read the structure as bullish but short-term overheated: daily RSI 70.24, 4h RSI 72.63, and Friday's high of 4,632.22 tagged the daily upper Bollinger band at 4,632.94 before fading 29.56 points into the close. agreements: Both producers report the same W34 weekly candle: open 4,376.16, high 4,632.22, low 4,324.80, close 4,602.66 (+226.50, +5.18%).

Both independent reports use the same frozen automated run and the same finalized primary TradingView snapshot, so their evidence identity is shared and their claim-by-claim comparison is eligible for multi-source publication.

The CFTC positioning figures for the 2026-08-18 report date were transcribed independently by each producer from the same official image and matched exactly, and both matched the official CSV on all seven fields: open interest 406,260 (+5,951), managed money long 154,595 (+5,961), short 12,947 (+1,975), spread 15,591 (+1,588), net long 141,648 (+3,986).
No unfilled bearish 4h fair-value gap sits above price; overhead resistance comes from Bollinger bands and April–May supply.
Both end on the same single recommendation: conditional waiting, no chasing early in the week.
No employment or consumer-price release falls in the forecast week, so the Friday forced-close rule is not triggered.
disagreements: Scenario ranking: one producer ranks range first at 40/35/25 (range/bullish/bearish), the other ranks bullish first at 45/35/20. The probability split is judgement rather than a directly verifiable fact, so it was left unresolved rather than averaged; the published ordering follows the more conservative reading, supported by the overbought daily and 4h RSI and Friday's 29.56-point fade from the high.

Breakout trigger: one report triggers on a close above 4,632.22, the other only above 4,659.03. The stricter level was adopted, because 4,632.22–4,659.03 is a single cluster of upper Bollinger levels and April–May supply, and triggering inside it means entering in the middle of resistance.

Stop placement: the adopted 4,632.20 stop is a structural invalidation — below it the breakout has failed — but it sits only 27.8 points from the reference entry, which is 0.69x the 4h ATR of 40.17. That noise risk is published alongside the level rather than smoothed away; a wider stop below the 4,601.40–4,605.87 pivot is the alternative, with position size reduced to hold the same risk limit.

Reversal zone: one report puts the first left-side reversal zone at 4,543.87–4,563.26, the other only at 4,495.02–4,519.81. The deeper zone was adopted as the priority, because the reversal strategy has limited out-of-sample confidence and a hard weekly cap on entries.

Upside targets: 4,691.14–4,723.09 (April–May supply, verifiable from the daily series) was adopted over a round-number/extension estimate; the two converge, since the other report's own 2R projection of 4,715.60 falls inside that band.

Event detail: one report left the Friday keynote time unknown because the symposium agenda was unpublished; the other carried 22:00 Taipei from the central bank's own calendar. The calendar time was adopted after re-verification, and the second report's separate Friday employment-benchmark revision was kept — together they make Friday 22:00 Taipei the only double-event window of the week.

Liquidity sweep and positioning caveat: only one report documented the 08-19 sweep of the prior day's low and the fact that the positioning data cuts off on 08-18, before the breakout. Both were adopted, since each is directly verifiable from the source data.

recommendation.summary: Conditional waiting. The weekly structure is bullish but short-term overheated at the daily upper band, and the week carries a mid-week inflation print and a Friday double-event window. Do not chase early in the week: the breakout case only begins above 4,659.03 with a fresh formal signal, and the reversal case only inside 4,495.02–4,519.81 with a fresh live signal. Every entry, stop and target still requires confirmation on a live chart after the open.
